submission.natural_language_explanation: An induction (successor-copy) head: it fires above its resting write when the current token continues a verbatim multi-token stretch seen earlier in the context (about 4+ tokens: a repeated clause or sentence, a recurring code or markup line, or a repeated name/number/identifier), attending to the token that followed the earlier occurrence of the current token (mean induction weight 0.55 vs 0.04 duplicate and 0.03 previous-token); first occurrences, ordinary non-repeating prose, and isolated single-word duplicates stay near the resting write. It is selective, not broad (about 12% of scanned tokens active).
